Knowledge Base

Frequently Asked Questions (VAT Decision)

Voluntary VAT registration (under £90,000 turnover) is advantageous if your customers are VAT-registered B2B businesses (who can reclaim the VAT you charge) and you incur significant VAT on business purchases (hardware, software, ads, hosting) which you can reclaim from HMRC.
